candidate.definition_en: An open challenge or act of defiance.
candidate.explanation_ar: تحدٍّ علني أو عمل يعبر عن المجابهة والعصيان.

senses.definition_en: An open challenge or act of defiance.
senses.explanation_ar: تحدٍّ علني أو عمل يعبر عن المجابهة والعصيان.
examples: The speech was seen as an open defy to the ruling party.
Her refusal to stand was a quiet defy against the unjust rule.
He threw down a bold defy that none of his rivals dared to accept.
